Let me analyze the bug. The saturation upper clamp should be 127, but code writes 126. Let me fix.

Also `wire signed [8:0] extended={a[7],a}+{b[7],b};` — {a[7],a} is 9 bits, sign extended correctly. Sum range: -128..127 + -128..127 = -256..254, fits in 9 bits signed (-256..255). Good.

Clamp: if > 127 sum <= 127; if < -128 sum <= -128. Fix 126 → 127.

Let me write the fix.
